conventions.time_index: t_k = k*dt, k = 1..K (t_1 = dt, t_K = T); array index k-1 (mc83.py: t = np.arange(1,K+1)*dt)
conventions.output: x_k = G(0)*1 + sum_m a_m |G(j w_m)| cos(w_m t_k + chi_m + arg G(j w_m)); built by mc85_scan.output(a, chi mod 2pi) (the function stage2_common.evaluate_crn uses), bitwise equal to mc83.x for U
conventions.H_columns: [1, a_m cos psi_km, -a_m sin psi_km] for m = 1..4, psi_km = w_m t_k + chi_m; parameter order [G(0), Re G(jw_1), Im G(jw_1), ..., Re G(jw_4), Im G(jw_4)]; built by mc85_scan.regressors(a, chi mod 2pi, t), bitwise equal to mc83.H for U; recursion and MC use the same x_k, h_k arrays
conventions.chi_reduction: chi reduced mod 2pi before forming x and H (as stage2_common.evaluate_crn); all four inputs already lie in [0, 2pi)
conventions.trigger: as mc83.sod: send iff |z_k - r_k| >= Delta; k = 1 forced send; reference = noisy z_k at the last send
conventions.EN_main: A, B: E[N] with the discrete Phat (spec §4, internally consistent); exact-P E[N] recorded as the zero-cost diagnostic. v0: E[N] with the exact P of the prototype (its only E[N]); v0 has no omega-form Phat, so its Phat-E[N] is "not applicable"
conventions.reference_matrix: J_C = U at the same version, grid and margin; Delta m_D = log det J(u) - log det J_C; lambda_i = eigh(J(u), J_C) ascending; m_E = lambda_1

U.source_params: spec §5 table row U; mc83.py:5 (a=np.full(4,0.5); chi=np.zeros(4))

D.source_params: code_8_3_stage2/stage2_pkg/stage2/final_batch1.json records[0] (identical a, chi in stage2/pool_R2000.json records[40])
D.note: amp_nm_P5514.json (cited in spec §5) holds name=P5514, best_p=[0.25219196244096403, 0.24019225146422263, 0.24309097233583749, 0.2645248137589759] and no chi: it is not this point. Parameters taken from final_batch1.json records[0] as instructed by the user on 2026-10-19.

N.note: the log calls it "best evaluated point (not an optimum)"; spec §5 calls it the unbudgeted optimum

grids.nodes: z_i = z_0 + i h, z_0 = min x - margin, z = np.arange(min x - margin, max x + margin + h, h) as in the prototype
grids.n48: only by spec §6 (absolute-quantity p_obs off the version's predicted order by > 0.5, or sign change of d1, d2) or §7 (B/n=24 fails the MC comparison and the diagnostic extrapolation passes); then the full grid-switch rule (stability 24/48, W from J_48, U recomputed at n=48, report states the actual grid)
grids.U_relative: Delta m_D(U) = 0, m_E(U) = 1 identically: p_obs "not applicable"

margins.tail_check: 16*Delta, version B, n = 12, all four inputs (relative quantities need U at 16*Delta)

versions.v0: prototype density_recursion.py run(): exact P = ndtr(beta)-ndtr(alpha), F = cumsum(f)*h, F(s+-Delta) by slices F[sh:], F[:-sh] padded with F[-1] and 0; c_k by the prototype's inline formula; no normalisation
versions.B: omega_ij = 1 if |i-j| < M; 1/2 if |i-j| = M; else 0
versions.common_AB: ghat_{k,j} = g_k(z_j)/sum_j g_k(z_j); Phat_{k,i} = sum_j ghat_{k,j} omega_ij; m_{k+1,j} = m_{k,j} Phat_{k,j} + ghat_{k,j} sum_i m_{k,i} (1 - omega_ij); no renormalisation of m

implementation.v0: numpy, the prototype's arithmetic (regression reference only)
implementation.A_B: numba-jitted mass recursion, sliding-window sums by prefix sums, O(G) per step; c_k by mc83.cfun (numpy/scipy; the reviewed implementation is reused, not ported) evaluated on the index range where m_k != 0 (exact: m_k = 0 elsewhere); w_k = sum_i m_{k,i} c_k(z_i)
implementation.runtime: steady state: import and JIT compilation excluded (one warm-up call before timing); serial, one process, OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads = 1
implementation.runtime_pass_line: version B on the accepted grid (n = 24, or 48 if switched): steady-state single evaluation <= 15 s (numba line, spec §6, §9)

mc.draws: Z = np.random.default_rng(20261019).standard_normal((10000, K)); batch b = rows 500b .. 500b+499; trajectory z = x + sigma Z[i]; the same Z for all four inputs (common random numbers)
mc.trigger: stage2_common.sod_batch (bitwise equal to mc83.sod, check_trigger run first)
mc.weights: c_k = cfun(alpha, beta) at the pre-update reference, c_1 = 1, arithmetic of stage2_common.evaluate_crn
mc.point_estimates: from the pooled weights of all 10000 trajectories: Jbar = sigma^-2 sum_k wbar_k h_k h_k^T; batches only for se

acceptance.items: per input: E[N], S, log det J, tr(Dbar)/9, 45 upper-triangle elements of Dbar (49 x 4 = 196); paired Delta m_D of D, E, N vs U (3)
acceptance.whitening: W = J_rec^{-1/2}, J_rec = version B, n = 24 (n = 48 if the input switched); D_b = W Jhat_b W^T - I
